sources.title: LTIMindtree introduces new brand identity and positioning — LTM
Eclatprime announces Eclatprime and Lantiqx combining as Eclantiqx
Tenth Revolution Group — Our brands, including Revolent
Revolent — Part of Tenth Revolution Group
Blue Shield of California — About the independent member and corporate structure

limitations: The earlier catalogue is used only as a before-and-after name baseline, not as evidence about employers, people, teams or vacancies.
New means newly represented relative to that catalogue; it does not mean a newly founded company, a confirmed vacancy or a verified salary.
The comparison consolidates reviewed brands, rebrands and regional entities for conservative employer-group counting; the fresh map retains its individual employer records.
Tenth Revolution Group and Revolent are two fresh records counted as one new group. LTM is the existing LTIMindtree lineage; Eclantiqx and Lantiqx are covered through the existing Eclatprime lineage.
Blue Shield of California is a newly specific independent employer within the previous broad Blue Cross Blue Shield bucket and is shown as one refinement outside the 34 new groups.

These groups include global and adjacent-technology opportunities. H&M and TEKsystems were found through adjacent RPA or integration roles; inclusion alone does not establish a Pega team, Bengaluru eligibility, India remote eligibility or compensation.
